review: Independent fault-control driver, parser, mutation and recorded-outcome review
verdict: Passed within this bounded GCC generic fault-control scope. Recorded detection is normal completed behavioral failure, not compiler/crash/setup failure. Two representative binaries were independently rerun successfully as expected-failure controls.
driver_and_parser_review: The driver pins source/test HEAD and requires a clean tracked source/test/CMake diff against 3003569 before compiling private copies. The focused test fixture remains unchanged for all controls.

Mutations use checked unique replacements in private Engine.cpp copies. Old-engine control substitutes both exact prior Engine.cpp and Engine.h, with tests compiled against those matching private headers.

Compile and link stages require successful exit; their failures invalidate the experiment. Each linked probe uses its private Engine.o and the matching archive for other objects. Link maps reject archive Engine.cpp.o selection.

The parser requires exactly one full terminal 7488-check summary, empty stderr, normal expected exit, valid failure count and exactly one FAIL diagnostic per reported failure. A crash, timeout, missing/truncated/duplicate summary, trailing output or unsuccessful fixture cannot be called detected.
Independently executed parser self-test accepted two valid records and rejected all 12 invalid cases.

The gate requires an unmutated pass, all 11 mutant detections, old-engine detection and unchanged production/test/archive/object invariants. All recorded command/log hashes were independently verified.
behavioral_failure_scope: Per-field guard omissions fail corresponding recipient, cache/onset continuity, tail, smoothing and accepted-gate expectations.
Pedal-as-held failures are confined to pedal recipient and continuation contexts. CC121 exception removal fails the CC121 contexts.
Filtering all MPE pressure/timbre incorrectly fails manager, gap and role-transition contexts. Suppressing global pressure or ribbon routes fails global-exception contexts.

Cache-loss controls leave pre-onset no-tail writes intact and prevent writes only when an active released matching voice exists; later onset, changed-law, ARP/KAS and relevant reset cases detect them.
limits: Only the omitted-pressure-guard and CC121-exception binaries were rerun during this audit. Other results were independently validated from archived source, build/link records, hashes and complete logs.
No full driver or compiler was rerun and no production/test source file was edited.
The old-engine control is exact prior Engine.cpp/h plus the unchanged current focused fixture and matching remaining core archive objects. It is not a complete original historical binary build.
Fault detection is not exhaustive correctness, performance, native-host, sanitizer or broad compiler-profile qualification.
The reported corrected neighboring Tuning/PolyPressure runtime passes and broader active runs were not independently executed here.
After-invariants refer to the recorded fault-driver run. Later approved neighbor-fixture changes are separate; production and this focused fixture were previously verified unchanged across 04597f5.
